Leo: Heads-up — after the route-discovery shim landed in the Python SDK, the console quota graphs show these weird short spikes. Anyone else seeing double-counting?
Sasha: yup saw it this morning. spikes line up with short-lived cache misses that immediately retry.
Jamie: I think the shim is emitting a new route header per retry. console dedupe is keyed by X-Route-ID + timestamp so retries look like distinct requests.
Maria: repro steps? I can try to reproduce locally with the attachable sample app.
Jamie: repro: run load test with small TTL for route cache. curl example: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Route-ID: tenant:abc:route-123:${RANDOM}" \
     https://api.redwood-inference.dev/v1/generate
```
If the SDK regenerates the route header on fallback we end up with a new suffix each time.
Sasha: SDK code path is here: `client/_route_shim.py` — line where we fall back to `generate_route_hint()` re-attaches a random suffix when the handshake fails.
Leo: so two problems: SDK is non-deterministically varying route IDs, and console/dashboards assume stable IDs for dedupe. Fix could be SDK canonicalization or console dedupe by prefix.
Maria: preference is to fix SDK to keep route-ID stable for a short session scope. Changing console dedupe is riskier (affects historical dashboards).
Jamie: agree. I can open a small patch: preserve base route id and only append stable suffix per process, not per retry.
Sasha: +1. Also we should add a tiny migration in console: ignore route IDs with `:${RANDOM}` pattern for dedupe while we roll out SDK fix.
Leo: actionable: Jamie to PR SDK patch; Maria to add a console-side ignore rule and a flag for safe toggle; Sasha to add unit test and an e2e that hits console ingestion.
Jamie: will do PR today, label `devex/route-shim-stable-id`.
Maria: I'll add the toggle under Console -> Ingestion -> Dedupe rules, default off; ops can flip to test.
ops-bot: Note: canary deploy started for `devex/route-shim-stable-id` at 2024-06-12T15:30Z :rocket:
Sasha: once PR is up I'll run the load test and post the graphs. Thanks all.
Leo: thanks — this should clear up the noisy quota sparks. Keep updates here and @oncall if anything looks bad.
